name: Onna ga Muragaru Kaosu Bi-chi Feromon o Makichirasu Doutei Otoko ga Neriaruku!
original_name: オンナが群がるカオスビーチ　フェロモンをまき散らす童貞男が練り歩く！
source:
Hikaru, a hopeless virgin desperate to finally lose it this year, heads to the beach! But there's one problem: he thinks saying “I’ve got a huge dick” is a great pickup line. Naturally, it goes terribly. Not a single girl is into this awkward guy reeking of virgin energy. That night, he receives a shady letter and a drink from someone calling themselves the Virgin Savior “Drink this and you’ll be overflowing with pheromones. Women won’t be able to resist you.” Feeling mocked, Hikaru chugs it all—and the next day, a transformation begins. Suddenly, his scent is driving girls wild.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654030//]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Hikaru，一个绝望的处女，渴望今年终于失去它，前往海滩！但有一个问题：他认为说“我有一个巨大的鸡巴”是一句很好的搭讪台词。当然，情况会很糟糕。没有一个女孩会喜欢这个浑身散发着处女能量的尴尬男人。那天晚上，他收到了一封可疑的信和一杯酒，来自一个自称圣母救世主的人，“喝了这个，你就会充满信息素。女人将无法抗拒你。”光感到自己被嘲笑了，他把这一切都吞了下去——第二天，转变开始了。突然间，他的气味让女孩们疯狂。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654030//]Steam[/url]]
